highlights.description: Free SAST and SCA without GitHub Advanced Security: new `go-sast-gosec` and `go-sca-govulncheck` reusable workflows (no code-scanning upload, so they work on private repos)
Reusable TypeScript CI and lint workflows, a reusable MkDocs deployment workflow, and a reusable Go dependency auto-merge workflow
Multi-module (matrix) support and a centralized golangci-lint config across the shared Go workflows

added.description: `go-sast-gosec.yaml`: reusable gosec static-analysis workflow (fails on findings; no GHAS required)
Shared TypeScript CI and lint workflows
`runs-on` input for the go-lint and go-sast-codeql workflows
Multiple-Go-module support via matrix across the shared Go workflows

fixed.description: `check-latest` added to setup-go across the shared Go workflows
Heredoc YAML parsing in the auto-merge workflow
Auto-merge approval message simplified to a single line

documentation.description: Org CLAUDE.md updated for VisionStudio and a CI gotcha; merge-strategy guidance to preserve conventional commits
CONTRIBUTING guide updated to VisionStudio work tracking (replacing the retired prismctl/prism-control references)
